notes.title: Post Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have considered community feedback and it's our pleasure to present you with the latest patch notes:

- Fixed a potential issue preventing some players to open up the main menu when having a controller plugged in.
- Increased the walking speed of the character by 30%
- Added more hints and tutorials throughout the game
- Added the ability to skip the intro cutscene
- Fixed the cutscene saving that it had already run when playing the first level
- Improved some of the visual foliage pop in and render range for lower to mid end PC's
- Added auto save feature to the first level
- Several general gameplay bug fixes
- Fixed several interaction highlights appearing too soon and causing confusion to players

We will continue to make improvements as we work towards the finalization of Part 2. 
Thank you for being a part of our community.

notes.title: Shadow Falls Release Imminent!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to present the upcoming early access release of Shadow Falls Part 1 and will be updating the game frequently with community feedback to make Shadow Falls the best possible. 

We aim to bring you Part 2 soon and this will form part of the base game which requires no additional purchases.

Thank you for being part of our brain child and helping make the dream come true. We hope you enjoy your time playing and we are looking forward to the community feedback. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065542/6b5c95574c5da21773c30a89ffd5737aef9a5139.jpg[/img]
